mode: targeted literature search and identification experiment
verification_scope: Five DOI metadata records checked with Crossref; one arXiv full text examined; local experimental metrics verified separately

claims.claim_text: Published approaches support sideslip-free estimation, bank/bias-aware adaptation and LPV input-output identification under their respective assumptions.
The derived reduced yaw/acceleration equation alone admits a continuum of conditional stiffness/inertia solutions.
The MnCAV follow-up tests improve yaw prediction but do not establish physical parameters or remove the second-drive lateral discrepancy.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: Do not present the independently derived diagnostic as a full reproduction of the beta-less or EKF papers.
Do not equate accurate yaw prediction with identified physical parameters or validated lateral velocity.
Distinguish numerical/profile sensitivity from statistical confidence intervals.

disclosure: AI-assisted literature search, derivation, implementation and result checking; no claim of independent human review.
